meta_description: 75 likes, 11 comments - mypoortiredliver on October 26, 2026: "I’m here to report that I’ve switched out of “mourning the end of summer” and am now fully embracing fall. ☀️🍑 ➡️ 🍁🍂 The end of peach season specifically always makes this Georgia-born gal a little teary, but this giant bag of fresh @thepeachtruck pecans is patching my heart up real fast! ❤️‍🩹 First order of business? A big, warm batch of @budgetbytes Candied Pecans! I insist you watch to the end to see my daughter’s comedy routine. 🤣  Get the recipe here 👉 https://www.budgetbytes.com/candied-pecans/".
